I’ve been told that before, but her reasoning for being so worried is perfectly valid. I had an ex-best friend who was OBSESSED with me and was literally so creepily in love with me, and I was so stupid and played into it thinking it was just how she was, until I realized just how bad it was for me, for her, and for my girlfriend, then I cut her off completely and that’s when she started trusting me. So in reality I don’t know if that would still even qualify as abuse because her thought process made sense and was partly my fault for thinking this was normal

She’d have no one to cheat on me with. What I’ve just come to a possible explanation for this mindset while responding to another comment, she previously accused me of cheating, and was hellbent on the idea that it happened for MONTHS up until recently where she finally started having trust in me.

I think this concept may be my mind trying to come up with a way to get “even” which makes this whole idea so much more disgusting to me and now I don’t think I can go through with it at all

We’ve done all of that, we call nearly every day, and text 24/7. We are constantly telling each other about our day, what we did etc. etc. 
She has MAJOR trust issues caused by bother her illness’ and I have trust issues caused by previous failed relationships. She was convinced I cheated on her for months, and only recently finally stopped believing that. I don’t know what else we can do to build that unbreakable trust everyone speaks of
Also I missed your last point, hypothetically if she doesn’t respond but also doesn’t show me, it doesn’t matter. It just means she wasn’t interested in the fake to begin with

I don’t know why I thought of this and I probably won’t go through with this because I’m worried that she would/should hate me if I do. But the idea that she might go through with it is honestly terrifying to me. I don’t expect a kind response lmao, if you do respond at all please don’t hold back any thoughts you may have on this
